# Cothren Plumbing & Construction Services, LLC

> Family owned plumbing and construction company based in Lovell, Wyoming, serving the Big Horn Basin. Owned by Alex and Natalia Cothren. Emergency plumbing calls 24 hours a day, 7 days a week. Licensed and insured, with more than 13 years of experience. Motto: "Built right. Fixed right. Done right."

- Phone (24/7 emergency plumbing): (307) 578-7873
- Natalia Cothren (scheduling and job applications): (307) 272-3858
- Email: cothrenplumbing@gmail.com
- Google rating: 5.0 from 30 reviews. Facebook: 100% recommend.

## Services

- Plumbing: 24/7 emergency calls, leaks and repairs, water heater repair and replacement, sewer and drain lines, bathroom and kitchen plumbing, rerouting plumbing in older homes, shop and modular home plumbing
- HVAC
- Remodels: full and partial remodels, bathroom remodels, flooring, framing, drywall, painting, window installation
- New construction: homes, shops, sheds and garages, building and repairing decks and fences
- Dirt work and outdoor: excavation, dirt work, concrete, irrigation, pump and sprinkler installation and repair, custom landscaping
- Trailer and equipment rentals: daily or weekly, easy pickup and drop-off

## Service area

Lovell, Wyoming and the Big Horn Basin.
